verse.verse_1: By the night, when it envelops,
verse.verse_2: and by the day when it unveils.
verse.verse_3: And by Who created the male and female,
verse.verse_4: your striving is indeed to different ends!
verse.verse_5: For him that gives and fears (Allah)
verse.verse_7: We shall surely ease him to the Path of Easing;
verse.verse_8: but for him that is a miser, and sufficed,
verse.verse_10: We shall surely ease for him the Path of Hardship (the Fire).
verse.verse_11: When he falls (into Hell), his wealth will not help him.
verse.verse_13: and to Us belong the Last and the First.
verse.verse_14: I have now warned you of the Blazing Fire,
verse.verse_15: in which none shall be roasted except the most wretched sinner,
verse.verse_17: and from which the cautious shall be distanced.
verse.verse_18: He who gives his wealth to be purified,
verse.verse_19: and confers no favor upon anyone for recompense
verse.verse_20: seeking only the Face of his Lord, the Most High,
